title: Noise-Aware Bayesian Optimization for Precision Improvement of Micro-Volume Liquid Handling in In Vitro Diagnostics.
summary: Bayesian optimization with a Gaussian process (noise-aware) tunes pump settings for micro-volume dispensing, measured experimentally to cut CV by 81.8% versus engineer settings; the optimizer is the enabling AI role with measured evaluation. The result is reported in the Micromachines. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
